issues.message: 遗漏常用的“时候／时机”“经历”“倍数／乘法”功能；“时期”和动词“安排时间”也不宜仅列为少见义。补充或提升为核心义，每义提供两个例句。
timer 的构词拼写说明错误：time 去掉词尾 e，再加 -er，得到 timer；保留 e 再加 -er 会拼成 timeer。
词源正文包含制作说明；阶段的 meaning 只是来源关系占位，没有提供古英语字形的释义。将可证实的 tima 来源保留在 summary，清空占位阶段。
实际取得的材料没有 Oxford 页面，不能将其作为全课具体内容的依据。改引实际取得的法语维基词典英语词条；专业知识补充项不虚挂来源。
多处例句缺少目标结构必填的 note 字段，需要补齐。
“time 作动词时专指测量时间”忽略其安排时间义；untimed 的说明混淆了记录用时与设置时限。
time 的可用时长不等同于 deadline；音乐义不是单个节奏单位。原词条列出的暂停、定语及分期相关用法也需交代适用范围。
this time 表示“这一次”，应关联次数／某次发生义，而不是抽象时间义。
将 /taim/ 称为“字母拼读方式近似标音”不准确，改为直接说明现代音标及发音。
跑三圈更自然地表达为 three laps；为突出次数，将情境改成同一段短跑完成三次，并采用 once、twice、three times。

review.coverageAssessment: 已核对词条释义及实际取得的英语词条内容。修订后，抽象时间与可用时长、钟点、次数、时期、时机、经历、倍数及乘法、计时和安排时间均有核心教学覆盖，每个核心义至少两个原创英中例句；限定时长、音乐节拍、体育暂停、定语和旧式赊购用法保留简要说明。历史词源仅保留可证实的古英语 tima 来源，不补造其释义或更早阶段。未扩展全部专业领域的固定表达。

senseInventory.sense: 时间；持续时长；可用时间
senseInventory.assessment: 现有两例分别覆盖剩余时长和有空做事；补充可数性说明。
保留询问钟点例句，并将第二例改为直接包含 time 的自然表达。
覆盖复数次数和单次经历，保留 once、twice 的数量表达说明。
原稿遗漏；新增比例与乘法例句，并说明其与次数表达的区别。
原稿遗漏；新增 it is time to 和 the right time 等常用表达。
由少见义提升为核心义，分别举例说明某个过去阶段和当前困难时期。

senseInventory.sense: 经历；过得如何的一段时间
senseInventory.assessment: 原稿遗漏常用的 have a good time 与 have a hard time doing，现补充教学。

senseInventory.sense: 限定时长；规定可用时间
senseInventory.assessment: 区分可用时长、time limit 和截止日期 deadline；修正 out of time 的翻译。
修正为音乐节拍或节奏组织，避免解释成单个节奏单位。
补充 call time 的体育语境，不推广为所有暂停均可直接说 time。

senseInventory.sense: 测定用时；记录时间；计时
senseInventory.assessment: 原有两例自然；补齐字段并限定近义表达的解释范围。

senseInventory.sense: 安排时间；选择时机；为……定时
senseInventory.assessment: 由少见义提升为核心义，补足句型、两例及与 mistime 的语境对照。

senseInventory.sense: 置于名词前，表示与时间或计时有关
senseInventory.assessment: 按具体名词搭配教学，不把“时间的、定时的、定期的”等视为可以自由替换的独立形容词义。

senseInventory.sense: 赊购；分期付款相关旧用
senseInventory.assessment: 补充旧式美语 on time，明确与现代常用的“准时”区分。

{"id":"n-moment","title":"时候；时机","meaning":"该做某事的时候，或适合让某事发生的时机。","usageNote":"It’s time to do 表示该做某事了；the right time 强调时机合适。不要把 It’s time to leave 中的 time 理解成剩余时长。","examples":[{"id":"n-moment-ex1","senseId":"n-moment","en":"It’s time to leave, or we’ll miss the bus.","zh":"该走了，不然我们会错过公交车。","note":"It’s time to leave 表示现在该出发了。"},{"id":"n-moment-ex2","senseId":"n-moment","en":"This isn’t the right time to ask Dad for a new bike.","zh":"现在不是向爸爸要一辆新自行车的合适时机。","note":"the right time to do 强调做某事的合适时机。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"It’s time to do something.","zh":"该做某事了。","note":"to 后接动词原形；表示到了应当行动的时候。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"It’s time for something.","zh":"到……的时候了。","note":"for 后接名词，如 It’s time for lunch。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"the right time to do something","zh":"做某事的合适时机","note":"强调时机合适，不是测量做事用了多久。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"the right moment","zh":"合适的时机","note":"在强调行动时机时与 the right time 接近；moment 更突出某个具体瞬间。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"the wrong time","zh":"不合适的时机","note":"与 the right time 对照；不表示钟表显示错误。"}],"similarNote":"这里比较的是行动时机，不是时长。","contrastingNote":"right 与 wrong 在时机是否合适这一语境中形成对照。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary_time"]}

{"id":"n-period","title":"时期；时代；时局","meaning":"某个生活或历史阶段，也可指某一时期的社会状况。","usageNote":"at that time 常指那时；in those times 指那个时代。谈某类时期或时局时可用复数 times，如 difficult times。","examples":[{"id":"n-period-ex1","senseId":"n-period","en":"At that time, I lived with my grandparents.","zh":"那时，我和祖父母住在一起。","note":"at that time 指过去那个阶段，不一定是某个钟点。"},{"id":"n-period-ex2","senseId":"n-period","en":"These are difficult times for small shops.","zh":"对小商店来说，现在日子很艰难。","note":"difficult times 指困难时期或艰难的经营环境。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"at that time","zh":"那时；在那个时期","note":"根据上下文确定所指阶段。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"collocations":[{"en":"difficult times","zh":"困难时期","note":"times 为复数，侧重某时期的状况。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"period","zh":"时期；阶段","note":"强调一段有范围的时间；可在 a difficult period 等表达中与本义接近。"},{"en":"era","zh":"时代","note":"通常指具有鲜明特点的较大历史阶段，不宜替换所有日常的 time。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"good times / hard times","zh":"好日子／艰难时期","note":"在生活或经济状况的语境中形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"period 范围较广，era 通常更有历史阶段感。","contrastingNote":"时期本身没有固定反义词；可以对照不同时期的处境。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary_time"]}

{"id":"n-experience","title":"经历；过得……的一段时间","meaning":"与形容词搭配，说明一段经历愉快、糟糕、轻松或困难。","usageNote":"此义常用单数 a ... time。have a good time 表示玩得开心；have a hard time doing 表示做某事很困难。这里的 a 不表示发生了一次。","examples":[{"id":"n-experience-ex1","senseId":"n-experience","en":"We had a great time at the picnic.","zh":"我们在野餐时玩得很开心。","note":"a great time 描述愉快的经历，不是在数次数。"},{"id":"n-experience-ex2","senseId":"n-experience","en":"I had a hard time putting the shelf together.","zh":"我费了很大劲才把架子组装好。","note":"have a hard time 后接 doing，表示做这件事很费劲。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"have a good / great time","zh":"玩得开心；过得愉快","note":"time 在这个表达中可数，通常保留 a。","kind":"fixed-expression"},{"en":"have a hard time doing something","zh":"做某事很困难","note":"用 doing 说明遇到困难的活动。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"have a wonderful time","zh":"过得非常愉快","note":"常用于旅行、聚会等经历。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"enjoy oneself","zh":"玩得开心","note":"在愉快经历的语境中接近 have a good time。"},{"en":"have difficulty doing something","zh":"做某事有困难","note":"接近 have a hard time doing，不用于替换愉快经历义。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"have a terrible time","zh":"过得很糟糕","note":"与 have a good time 对照。"},{"en":"have an easy time doing something","zh":"做某事很轻松","note":"与 have a hard time doing 对照。"}],"similarNote":"根据经历是愉快还是困难，分别选择对应表达。","contrastingNote":"good 与 terrible 比较感受；hard 与 easy 比较做事难度。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"n-multiple","title":"倍数；乘以（times）","meaning":"times 跟在数字后可表示数量比例；在算式中可表示乘以。","usageNote":"three times as much 表示数量是三倍，不是多三倍；乘法中的 times 不表示发生次数。表达三倍关系时，three times as ... as 比 three times ...er 更清楚。","examples":[{"id":"n-multiple-ex1","senseId":"n-multiple","en":"This bag costs three times as much as that one.","zh":"这个包的价格是那个包的三倍。","note":"总价为三倍，不是原价再增加三倍。"},{"id":"n-multiple-ex2","senseId":"n-multiple","en":"Three times four is twelve.","zh":"三乘四等于十二。","note":"算式中的 times 表示乘以。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"three times as ... as ...","zh":"是……的三倍……","note":"可用于长度、重量或数量等比较，如 three times as long as。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"A times B","zh":"A 乘以 B","note":"用于读乘法算式；这里不是名词次数。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"three times as much","zh":"三倍那么多","note":"两倍常说 twice as much；这与 twice 表示两次的功能不同。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"multiplied by","zh":"乘以","note":"在算式中与 times 接近，不能替换表示次数的 times。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"half as much","zh":"一半那么多","note":"在比例比较中可与 twice as much 对照，属于数值关系而非词汇反义。"}],"similarNote":"乘法读法与次数用法要分开。","contrastingNote":"倍数没有统一反义词；可按具体数量比较倍数与分数。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary_time"]}

{"id":"v-schedule","title":"安排时间；选择时机","meaning":"安排活动发生的时间，或有意选择合适时机做某事。","usageNote":"time something for ... 表示安排在某时；time something to do ... 表示选择时间以达到某个目的。与测量活动用了多久的计时义区分。","examples":[{"id":"v-schedule-ex1","senseId":"v-schedule","en":"We timed our visit for the school holiday.","zh":"我们把访问安排在学校假期。","note":"for 后说明访问安排在哪个时段，不是访问持续多久。"},{"id":"v-schedule-ex2","senseId":"v-schedule","en":"I timed my call to catch her before she left for work.","zh":"我选好打电话的时间，赶在她出门上班前联系上她。","note":"to catch her 说明选择通话时间的目的。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"time something for a particular time","zh":"把某事安排在特定时间","note":"for 后接计划发生的时间或时段。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"time something to do something","zh":"选择某事的时间，以便……","note":"不定式说明选择该时间的目的。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"time a visit","zh":"安排访问时间","note":"在安排日程的语境中使用；若谈访问用了多久，则可能是计时义。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"schedule","zh":"安排日程","note":"强调计划某事何时进行；time 还可突出对行动时机的拿捏。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"mistime","zh":"弄错……的时机","note":"用于行动过早、过晚或时机不合适，与 time something well 对照。"}],"similarNote":"schedule 偏重日程，time 可偏重恰当时机。","contrastingNote":"mistime 是此义相关的否定派生词，不表示没有测量用时。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary_time"]}

patches.expectedValueJson: "time + -er，表示执行计时的人或计时工具。"
patches.valueJson: "time 去掉词尾 e，再加 -er，构成 timer，表示计时的人或工具。"

patches.expectedValueJson: "以不发音的 e 结尾的 time 加 -er 时保留 e。"
patches.valueJson: "拼写为 tim + er → timer，只有一个 e；不能写成 timeer。"
"这里的 timer 是会在设定时间结束时响铃的计时器。"
"timing 是名词，指访问时间选得是否合适，不是访问持续的时长。"
"timely 虽以 -ly 结尾，这里仍是形容词，修饰 advice。"

patches.expectedValueJson: "这些词由 time 加常见后缀构成；注意 timing 去掉 e，timer 和 timely 保留 e。"
patches.valueJson: "这些是现代构词关系：timing 是 tim + ing，timer 是 tim + er，二者都先去掉 time 的词尾 e；timely 是 time + ly，保留 e。timely 是形容词，不因以 -ly 结尾就变成副词。"
